name: Home1
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Chocola loves you, Master!
How do you feel about me,
Master?

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Chocola's heart races just
by being near you,
Master... I want your
heart to race too, Master!

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Master, Chocola worked
really hard today~!
Please pat my head
as my reward, nya!♪

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Master, do you know what
Chocola wants you to do?
...Nya!♪ Amazing, Master,
that's right~! Purrr~

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Nyanya! This is so
yummy...! Chocola feels
really happy now!

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Nya~ I'm so happy!
Chocola wants to be
with you always, Master!

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Chocola loves you so much,
Master...! I want you to
pay more attention to me!

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
*fidget fidget...*
I want to play with you,
Master... I want to
play with you, Master~

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
I want you to
pet me, nyan~

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Good morning, Master!
Chocola is feeling
great today~!♪

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
Hello and wyelcome!
...Huh? Master? Tee hee♪
Do you need Chocola
for something?

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
Chocola is still ready
to go! Master, what
should we do now?

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
Fnyaa~... The warm sun
feels so nice~ Zzz... 
zzz... Nya! I-I wasn't
asleep! I wasn't asleep!

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
I worked so much that
I'm all sweaty!
Master, let's take
a shower together!♪

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Master! Master!! Have you
finished the new fall
cakes yet?! Chocola is
ready to taste test them!

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
Master, isn't it cold in
your bed? It is, right?!
Chocola will sleep with
you and warm you up!♪

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year!
Let's be together
all year round, Master!

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Tada!♪ Here's my present
for you! It's special
chocolate packed with
things I think are yummy!♪

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Since it's Neko Day, let's
add "nya" to the end of
our sentences! Master,
you go nya too, nya~!♪

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
I hope that I can stay
with Master forever...!
Please, please
make that come true!

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Wham! Coochie-coo~!
Poke poke♪ Hmph...
Fine, then! Ackee will
play by herself!

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Chocola's been a good
girl, so Santa will come
this year too, right?
Right?

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
This year was so much fun!
I'm sure that next year
will be a fun one, too!

name: Birthday Wishes
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
Master, please look this
way. It's a birthday
present from your
catpanion... Smooch♪

name: Event
sceneName: ホーム会話（イベント開催時）
transcription:
Master, something over
there seems like fun...
Let's check it out!

name: Home1
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Snff snff... fnya...
Master... you have a nice
scent♪ Chocola's the best,
but I like yours, too.

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
When I think about you,
Master, my heart races...
My chest feels warm...
This might be happiness.

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
I'm happy when I get to be
with you, Master... Do you
think I'm lying? Nekos
only lie very rarely.

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Hmm... I feel a gaze on
me... Probably a lewd
one... but it's Master's,
so that's just how it is.

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
My work is perfect. Everyone tells me I'm a quick learner.
I think you could afford to praise me a bit more too, Master.

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Master, you're here and keeping me company...
Now, if only Chocola were here, everything would be perfect.

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Hmmm~~ ...Master, are you
the type who takes those
close to you for granted?

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
Master, it's troubling how
unaware of yourself you
are. You need to pay more
attention to your nekos.

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription: Master, you were totally flirting with the customers. You really should pamper me more... or I might just wander off. Cats are capricious, after all.

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Fnya... Mornings start
late for nekos...
I wish you'd let me
sleep a little longer...

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
A customer praised us.
They said our cakes are
tasty... I feel happy when
you're praised, Master.

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
The time after work is
vital for nekos and their
masters... Physical
affection is vital, too.

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
It's so warm that I'm
sleepy... So I'll sleep...
with Chocola... Naptime...
You too, Master...

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
Master... you just looked
at someone whose clothes 
were clear from sweat...
Such a lewd pâtissier.

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
One of the neighborhood
shops has fall fruit now.
Master, how about we
check it out later?

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
If we had a kotatsu and
mikans in the break room,
everyone could be warm and
happy... Nice idea, huh?

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year!
I'll be by your side this
year, too, Master...♪

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
I've been looking forward
to Valentine's. You didn't
notice? ...You've got
lots to learn, Master.

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Meow♪ Today is Cat Day... which means it's our day.
So, I'll allow you to pamper me to your heart's content.

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
Hmm... Both Oma tuna
and Matsuzaka beef are
amazing... Which one would
you wish for, Master?

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Cosplaying for Halloween
looks like fun. What
outfit do you want to see?
...Y-You lewd pâtissier!

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Master... it's Christmas,
so let's swap gifts.
It's okay. I trust your
taste... I can't wait♪

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription: Lazing around at the end of the year is the best... So chill, so cozy♪

name: Birthday Wishes
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
For a catpanion, their
lover's birthday is a
special day. I'll make
yours super great... Master

sceneName: ホーム会話（イベント開催時）
transcription:
Nya! Something is pinging
my neko senses...! It
feels like something fun
is happening over there!

name: Home1
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
When you smile,
Onii-san... I feel like I
can do my best today, too.
How about you... Onii-san?

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
If you look at me so much,
Onii-san, it makes me
blush. But... can we stay
like this a little longer?

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Good work today, Master.
Please don't push
yourself, and rest if
you get tired, okay?

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
I love looking at and
raising flowers.
What kind of flowers
do you like, Master?

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
I'm going to do my best to
be more useful to you,
Master, so... hee hee,
ask me for anything, okay?

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Onii... no, I mean Master!
I almost called you
Onii-san, even though
we're working right now.

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
...I'd like for you to
look at me a little more,
Onii-san... But that would
be selfish, wouldn't it?

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
If you leave me be, then
my work efficiency might drop...
Hee hee, just kidding, Master.

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
I'm on standby if you have
any requests, so I can
handle them at any time!

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Good morning. The morning
light is so lovely...
Here's to today being a
wonderful day.

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
The shop's so bright at
this time of day, it warms
my heart! I wonder if the
flowers are happy. Hee!♪

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
How about enjoying some
tea during this quiet
evening? I'll brew some
for you, okay?♪

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
Springtime air is gentle,
and smells of flowers when
you walk outside...
I love this season!♪

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
The sun is so strong in
the summer, so please be
sure to stay hydrated,
okay? That's a promise.

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
As I walk over colorful
leaves, my heart feels
warm, even if it's cooler
now... Why is that?

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
The whole town grows quiet
when it snows. It feels
like time is slowing
down... It's wonderful.

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year!
I hope that this
year is a nice
and peaceful one.

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
In France, we send roses
for Valentine's Day. Umm,
if it's okay... would you
accept the flowers I grew?

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Hee hee, when people hear
that it's Neko Day,
they're so kind to me...
It's kind of embarassing♪

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
Writing your wish on paper
is a lovely tradition.
I'll do it, too...
What should I write?

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Trick or treat...!
Hee hee, I want to give
candy to the children too!

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Merry Christmas... I'm
glad we're together again
this year. Will Santa
bring me happiness, too?

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
So much has happened this
year. Looking back on it
makes me happy and sad...
It just fills my heart.

name: Birthday Wishes 3
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
Onii-san, happy...
birthday! Umm, today
I'll... grant any wish
you have, Onii-san!

name: Birthday Wishes 2
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、飼いネコ以上））
transcription:
Master, happy birthday.
These are some flowers
I worked hard to grow.
Will you accept them?

name: Birthday Wishes 1
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー））
transcription:
Master, happy birthday.
Please forget about work
today, and get some rest.

name: Event
sceneName: ホーム会話（イベント開催時）
transcription:
It looks like there's
an event going on.
...I'll do my best, too!

I'm afraid I lost myself in some gardening books 
at the bookstore.

name: Slacking:2-1
sceneName: 汎用ボイス_サボり_発見された2-1
transcription:
Did you step away from your work 
just to come find me?
Hehe, that makes me happy♪

name: Slacking:1-2
sceneName: 汎用ボイス_サボり_アイテム獲得1-2
transcription:
Oh? There's something lovely here...
Hehe, this will be a lovely memory 
to look back on♪

name: Slacking:2-2
sceneName: 汎用ボイス_サボり_アイテム獲得2-2
transcription:
Even a small discovery feels twice as special when we find it together.
Sharing the happiness...hehe♪

name: Slacking:1-3
sceneName: 汎用ボイス_サボり_帰宅する1-3
transcription:
I can't believe 
I don't want to go back to work yet...
That's not like me at all, is it?

name: Slacking:2-3
sceneName: 汎用ボイス_サボり_帰宅する2-3
transcription:
For a moment we were able to forget 
about work and just relax.
Hehe, it'll be our little secret, okay?

name: Home10

When I wear Soleil's uniform it makes me feel like I'm part of the family.
And that...hehe, makes me really happy♪

name: Home11
sceneName: ホーム会話_カード
transcription:
Uniforms are mysterious. When I wear one, I feel motivated somehow♪
I'll support you with everything I have!

name: Home12
sceneName: ホーム会話_カード(覚醒）

I'm especially good with office work and accounting.
And... When people need me, it makes me feel all warm inside~♪

name: Home13
sceneName: ホーム会話_カード(覚醒）

Working at a shop I love, with someone I trust...
Hehe, I wonder... Is it really okay for me to be this happy?

This outfit...the gym uniform...is easy to move in, but...

name: Home15

Wearing the same outfit and working together toward a shared goal!
Maybe sports days and work aren't so different after all♪

name: Home16

When I think of sports days, I think of relay races, tug-of-war, and rolling the giant ball...
I like the individual events too, but I really love team events where everyone works together♪

name: Home17
sceneName: ホーム会話_カード(覚醒）

One of the best parts of sports day is the lunch, right?
Fried chicken, tamagoyaki, sausages... What kind of side dishes do you like?

Having the people I love
celebrate my special

Thank you so much!♪

name: Trip
sceneName: カード初獲得
transcription:
Hehe,
let's make lots of wonderful
memories together♪

name: Home14
sceneName: ホーム会話_カード
transcription:
I understand wearing a swimsuit at the beach, but...
Um, it's a little embarrassing. Please don't stare too much!

name: Home15
sceneName: ホーム会話_カード
transcription:
Um, out of pure curiosity...
Does this swimsuit look good on me? No, never mind! It's nothing!

name: Home16
sceneName: ホーム会話_カード(覚醒）
transcription:
The sound of the waves and the sea breeze...and the seagulls...
Just standing here feels soothing, doesn't it?

name: Home17
sceneName: ホーム会話_カード(覚醒）
transcription:
The sun sinking below the horizon is so romantic.
Being able to watch it with someone dear to me... It makes me very happy.

name: Home1
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Wh-What is it? Don't be
starin' at me like that!
...You're makin' me blush.

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
You've got some whipped
cream on your cheek. Geez,
you're hopeless. Come on,
lean over... Mlem.

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Heheh♪
Looking pretty put together.
How about you keep it up?

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Want me to be manager? 
I'll be on break most of the
time, though.

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Seriously, I didn't think
I'd be working this much.
...I-I don't really mind,
though.

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
It's a lot of pressure
to be counted on so much~
Well, it's not exactly
a bad thing~

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
You know, I'm working
pretty hard here, too...
so be sure to reward me
for it, okay?

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
You've got some wandering
eyes on you, don't you~?

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
Why are you spacing out~?
If you do that, then
you'll be setting a bad
example for the nekos.

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Hey now, you're up awful
early! Me? I've... always
been an early riser!

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
We've gotten pretty busy
here...! Hey, do you want
me to help you out?

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
Whew... Good work today.
You're tired too, right?
Be sure to get some rest.

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
It's hard to be motivated
at this time of year, ya
know~ ...Heh, I'll still
do my work, though~

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
The inside of the shop is
so cool, it's heaven~♪
Huh? A delivery?
And you want me to go~?

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Be careful not to catch
a cold, you hear?

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
Brr, it's so cold~!
Hey, make some kind of
sweets that warm you up~!

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year! They say
that the first day is when
you make your plans...
so we can slack off today!

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Valentine's really
ain't my thing, but...
if you don't mind,
then take this...

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Nya! I heard today's
Neko Day! You can
cuddle up to me and
say "nyaan", okay?

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
Waugh! D-Dummy, don't just
peek like that! I'm not
making any major kind of
wish, stop wondering!

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Halloween's when kids play
around, right? So it's got
nothin' to do with a
grown-up neko like me.

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Merry Christmas!
Well... I guess events
like this are okay
every once in a while.

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
It's been so busy at the
shop that the year just
flew by. It was a pretty
fun year, though!

name: Birthday Wishes
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
Umm, well... it's your
birthday, right? Can I
have some of your time
once work is over...?

name: Event
sceneName: ホーム会話（イベント開催時）
transcription:
Oh, it looks like they're
doing something fun.
Let me join in!

name: Home11

Gotta make sure I don't get this uniform dirty.

name: Home4

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）

I need to work hard so
that people talk about
more than just how tall
I've gotten!

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Onii-chan, you're
everyone's Master, so you
can't just pay attention
to me, right...

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
Onii-chan, you seem so
busy...! Is there anything
I can do to help you?

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
I wonder if I've been
abandoned... No, Onii-chan
would never do something
like that...

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Morning! I'm going to do
my best to make zero
mistakes today!

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
Are you tired? If there's
anything I can do,
just say what.

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
Onii-chan... umm, would
it be okay to have you
pamper me a little?

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
It's so warm, and the
weather is nice! It makes
me want to go outside
and do something!

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
Let's go to the beach or
the mountains for our next
vacation! I want to really
get in a workout!

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
The sweet potato truck
just went past! Do you
think we can put something
like that on our menu...?

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
If we get a lot of snow,
then we should make
a snowman out front!
Leave it to me!

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year!
I'm so happy that we
all get to be together
for it!

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
I want to give you some
homemade chocolates, too!
I wonder if I can
make them...?

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Nyan nyan...♪ Er, ah ha
ha... That kind of thing
doesn't really suit me,
huh...

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
I hope that I can get a
little more skillful
with my hands...!

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
I wonder what kind of
costume I should wear?
I'm not really sure what
would look good on me.

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Let's all have a Christmas
party together!♪ I want to
eat lots of tasty things!

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
We need to buy a lot of
things to get ready for
New Year's! You can leave
carrying the bags to me!

sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））

Thank you for
everything... smooch.
Tee hee... That was a
present from me.

What can I do... so that
my feelings will get
through more? ...I love
you so much, and yet...

Can you join me at our
next break? I want you to
hear me play guitar. Can
you tell me your thoughts?

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
You're really a straight
shooter, or maybe just
kind of clumsy... but I
don't mind that at all.

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
I meant to say this
before, but you give
everyone too much freedom.
Well, hey, it's your shop.

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
My claws? Yeah, I just
worked on them. Good eyes,
there. Hee hee♪ What do
you think? Pretty, right?

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Haa... What's going on
with you? Why did you...
I missed you so much...

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
You don't have to worry
about me or anything.
I know what I need to do.

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
You seem pretty busy.
I'm free right now.

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Oh. You've got some
bedhead going there. I
think you should take more
care of your appearance.

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
You need to take some
breaks, too. If you fall
over, then it's just more
problems for me.

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
I'm going to be practicing
my music until I go to
bed. I want to get
even better.

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
Fwaa... Wh-What are you
looking at? I wasn't
yawning or anything!

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
Is there a way to cool
things down? Hm? Turn off
the lights and tell scary
stories? N-Nope! No way!

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
I'll brew some black tea
that goes well with
fall sweets♪

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
It's dry this time of
year, so use hand lotion.
Are your hands dry?
Want some lotion?

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year! It looks
like this year is going
to be a good one, too♪

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
I tried making some
chocolates. Do you want
to try them? ...Yeah♪
Give them a good taste♪

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Huh? Even though it's Neko Day,
I don't really say "nya"?
N-Nya...nyanya... nyan nyan!♪
...H-How's that?

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
It feels like I wrote my
intent more than a wish
on my tanzaku. I want to
fulfill my dreams myself.

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
I might have a little
interest in cosplay...
Which version of me
are you interested in?

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
I've got plans to see the
Christmas lights later.
...Do you want to
come with me?

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
I'm going to relax at the
end of the year. How about
you do the same?
...Together with me.

sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
Happy birthday. I'll
celebrate it with you,
so... how about going on
a date with me?

name: Event
sceneName: ホーム会話（イベント開催時）
transcription:
It looks like they're
having a good time.
How about we go
check it out?

Do you think I'm a neko

name: Home6

There are times when I

name: Home7

name: Home9

You look so handsome when

Good morning!♪
Everything at the shop

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）

Good work today~♪ Napping
makes it harder to sleep
at night. A-Are you... not
going to let me sleep?!

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
I practice playing music
with May-chan at night~
But after that~...
J-Just kidding!♪

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
It's so warm~♪ On days
like this, I want to
cuddle up in a blanket and
be warm inside and out♪

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
May-chan was eating a
popsicle, and seeing her
lick it was just so...
Ohh, I'm going to drool!

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
I've been studying. They
say fall is for late-night
reading~ Reading what...?
Th-That's a secret.

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
Do you miss touching
nekos~? If you would
like... you can warm up
using me... ♪

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year!♪ I'll be
careful this year to not
suddenly start drooling~

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Do you like chocolate body

But after the chocolate,
dessert is... me, right?

sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Since it's Neko Day, will
everyone nyan nyan...
Everyone... nyan nyan,
nyan nyan... nya~~~♪

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
I hope to keep getting along
with May-chan and everyone♪
...And also, mmbl.
Mmbl... haah!♪ Haah!♪

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
If you don't give me
treats, then I, I...
Play a trick on me! Oh,
you mustn't!♪

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Santa won't come by if
I'm not a good girl,
right? B-But... I'm a
bad girl sometimes, so...

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）

to go and ring the
New Year's bell

please let me celebrate

drool a bit at the end...

already know of what I

Say, you, a tiny taste of 
some sweets won't hurt,

sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）

I have a darling little sister...

sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）

To think I have so much

I do wish you would
look my way...

sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）

Boredom is my greatest
adversary. If you fail to
amuse me, Proprietor,

You? 
Is it presumptuous of me

a little complacent...?

As morning breaks, so does
the clarity in my gaze...
So, onward we go
into this new day.

sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
Nya hee hee, the scent
of sweets makes my
belly grumble.

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
The late-night hours
make the heart restless.
But with me by your side,
there is nothing to fear.

sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
Seeing the swaying
blossoms with you is so
delightful... Hah?! You
heard... Ahem, a-at ease!

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
Shall we venture to the
summer festival together?
Fear not, I'll grasp your
arm tight in the crowd.

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Savoring dangos as we
gaze at the moon...
What a wonderful
long autumn night♪

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
I'd claim the cold has
no effect on me...
but I do feel it biting.
Come, nestle a bit closer.

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
A brand new year...
I love New Year's Day.
Time slows, letting us
spend eternity together.

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
I-I made some Japanese
sweets for you. This was
part of my training...
Not an expression of love!

sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Oh? It's Neko Day? Well,
I may be a nekomata...
but there's no harm in
being festive!

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
Nya hee hee... My wish
is top-secret. Does it
intrigue you? Hm?
Hmm??

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Trick or treat! Now hand
over some sweets. Hee
hee... It's a mysterious
night, and I'm the star.

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
So tonight's a holy
night... This calm,
quiet night reminds me
of the past.

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
The year-end bells evoke
a sense of finality.
I'd love to listen with
you in years to come.

Today is Young Master's

anything you wish. Hehe♪

it upon your eyes♪

The humidity tangles up
my fur and tail...
I hate it. What if I cut it short...?
S-Spare my tail, please!

sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）

Autumn feels so
melancholy...
But perhaps that's
part of its beauty.

sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）

You look cold.
I could warm you up...?
Actually, never mind.

I look forward to
spending the next year
together, too...

tasty... But it was
made with love.

everyone even more.

for everything. 
I hope you stay by my side
next year as well.

This uniform... D-Does it suit me?
I-Is that so...? Hehehe...

name: Home11

When I wear a big apron I feel at ease.
It almost makes me seem a little smaller, don't you think?♪

name: Home12
sceneName: ホーム会話_カード(覚醒）
transcription:
Being able to admire these beautiful cherry blossoms...with you...
I am very happy...

name: Home13
sceneName: ホーム会話_カード(覚醒）

Ah... It's not quite a proper lunch, but...
I baked some bread for today... There's plenty...plenty for everyone♪

sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
You mean the world
to me, Master...
S-Saying it
makes me blush~

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Master... I can't retain
my composure if you're
too close~ But... I'm not
saying I want you to go.

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Proprietor, I did a
splendid job today♪
As a reward, I request
a pat on the head~

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Nya~ Proprietor~ What
brings you here?
Wait, no... Can I help you
with something, my lord?

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Hm, that you noticed my
presence... As expected
from someone as
remarkable as you!

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Do not neglect to maintain
the tools of your trade.
Not that I've ever used a
kunai or a shuriken...

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Master... Hiding these
feelings of mine
is difficult.
Pay attention to me~

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
Proprietor... Even though
I adore you so...
This, too, is the fate
of the resilient...

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
Shinobi Neko Kurumi...
has arrived!
Heeey... I'm right here~?

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
I am the one who lurks
in the shadows...
Therefore, it is time
for me to go to bed~

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
All I have for lunch
is ninja rations!
Y-You're hearing things!
My stomach isn't rumbling!

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
It's the hour when shadows
move under the cover of
darkness... I shall
try my best!

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
It's easier to sneak
around when it's warm~
So warm and cozy... Unya~

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
Nya~! I camouflaged myself
as a tree, and beetles and
cicadas appeared! You'll
find no nectar here~

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Autumn is full of fallen
leaves! Ninja Arts: Leaf
Pile Camouflage! Nyaaa!
My apologies for the mess!

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
I am the one... 
Who lurks in the shadows...
P-Please spare me
delivery duties!

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year!
May we share another
year together...
if that's okay!

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Some sweet ninja rations,
from yours truly~
I-It's actually chocolate.

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Today is Ninja Day!
It's also Neko Day?!
Hmm... I'll celebrate both
since I'm a ninja neko~♪

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
I want to become an
amazing ninja! I'll clone
myself so I can help out
more around the store!

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Everyone is disguised
as pumpkins! Ho ho~
The ninja boom
has arrived!

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
I'm great at sneaking into
houses through chimneys,
too♪ Is it possible that
Santa's... a ninja?

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
You've helped me out
so much this year...
I hope I can do the same
for you next year!

name: Birthday Wishes 3
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
Master... As your
catpanion, here's to the
day of your birth!
...Smch!

name: Birthday Wishes 2
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、飼いネコ以上））
transcription:
Proprietor~! Happy
birthday~♪ I hope next
year is as marvelous
as the last~

name: Birthday Wishes 1
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー））
transcription:
Happy birthday~♪
I hope you celebrate
my birthday as well~

name: Event
sceneName: ホーム会話（イベント開催時）

It seems something's up...
I shall investigate! I'll
blend in with the crowd
and see what's going on!

I'd rather be the latter.

When you're by my side,
the world becomes so
colorful~♪ I wanna stay
like this forever♪

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Hehe, your smile makes
me so happy♪ So could
you show me more of
your cute face?

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Bussing tables is such a
precious job! Praise me
when I make them
sparkling clean~♪

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Huh? I'm too close?
Hehe, nekos really like
to get clingy♪

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Hey, listen up...
Coochie coochie coo~♪
Well? Did it give you
goosebumps?

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
No matter how down in
the dumps you get, I'll
make you happy for sure~♪

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Sweet words aren't my
forte, but just this
once... Nyaan!
Master, I love you♪

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
Snff snff... Smelling
sweet today! Ohh...
I just want to lick ya~♪

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
Do I look like I'm
teasing you? Non
non, this is important
physical contact!

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Good morning♪ Hehe, your
sleepy face is so cute~♪

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
Hey, can I give you a hug?
It's like a greeting,
you know?

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
You say, "The moon is so
beautiful" on romantic
nights, right? Oh? Your
face is a little red.

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
You have a sakura petal
on your hair. What a
very cute accessory♪

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
Summer is all about
ghost stories, right?
I'll hold your hand when
you get scared. No prob♪

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Hm~♪ This Mont Blanc
melts in my mouth!
Sharing it with you
makes it double the yum♪

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
Oh? Your hand is very
cold. Hehe, I'll use my
pocket to warm you up♪

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year!
Give me a looot to
enjoy this year, too!

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Happy Valentine's Day♪
Chocolates are sweet,
but I might be sweeter.

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Nyan nyan nyan♪ Today's
Cat Day! Hey... give me
lots of head pats, 'kay?

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
What did you wish for?
Huh, me? Well~... I
wished to be with my
beloved forever♪

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Trick or treat! Pranks
are acceptable today,
right? Watch out~♪

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Merry Christmas♪ Your
present is~ me...
Just kidding!

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
It's this year's finalé.
My best memories were
every day I spent
with you!

name: Birthday Wishes 3
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
Master, happy birthday♪
Will you accept my heart?

name: Birthday Wishes 2
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、飼いネコ以上））
transcription:
Happy birthday♪ Hehe, do
you want a present that's
sweeter than cake...?

transcription:
Today's your special
day, right? I'll gift
you the best day ever♪

transcription:
Master... If you keep
staring at me like that,
I won't be able to
work properly...

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Is it okay if I come a
little closer? Being close
to you calms me down.

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Sorry for spacing out!
Of course I wasn't
thinking about you.

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Do you need something?
Hold on a moment.
I'll be right with you!

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Do you need something?
As long as it doesn't interfere with my work,
I can help right now.

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Is something wrong?
If you need something,
I'll get it right away.

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
W-Was I too forward
in asking you out?!
Wh-What should I do?!

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
There's no rule that says
you have to pay attention
to me, but I feel lonely
when you ignore me...

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
If there's anything you
need me to do, please
don't hesitate to ask.

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Good morning.
I hope the day goes well.

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
Let's stay focused so we
can get our work done
without any mistakes.

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
It's almost closing time,
but let's do our best to
avoid making mistakes.

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
Folks tend to let their
guard down in spring.
Let's remain focused.

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
I'm worried about folks
not following dress code.
Since it's so hot, maybe
we should rethink it.

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Fall is all about food. 
Why not let everyone
sample our new menu items?

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
We curl up when it's cold.
Let's do our best to stay
warm and keep the indoor
temperature comfortable.

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year.
I'm counting on you to
help La Soleil continue
to grow this year, too.

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
If you have a moment,
there's something I want
to give you... J-Just a
customary seasonal gift!

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Today is Neko Day. No need
for anything fancy, but
since it's only once a
year... maybe it's okay?

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
Orihime and Hikoboshi...
It makes me sad knowing
they can only see each
other once a year.

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
No need to worry.
We have plenty of snacks.

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Christmas is a special
day, but let's do our job
while not overindulging
and following the rules.

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
It's the end of the year.
I hope we can ring in 
another peaceful New Year.

sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））

Is there anything you
want? I can grant any
wish you may have!

name: Birthday Wishes 2
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、飼いネコ以上））
transcription:
Happy birthday.
I got you a gift!
Th-That's what you
do on birthdays... right?

name: Birthday Wishes 1
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー））
transcription:
Happy birthday.
Here's a gift.
I hope you like it...

name: Birthday

I'm really happy!

sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Hey, Chief, I'm tipsy
and sleepy. Let me use
your lap as a pillow.

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Your hands are so warm...
I wish you would pet me
forever. Can you?

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Manager, come have a
drink with me. That's all
that matters right now.

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Manager, Manager!
If I open my mouth
real wide, will you
feed me lotsa snacks?

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
It's nice to take it easy
sometimes. Let's watch
the clouds drift by and
take a nap.

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Manager, are we really
not going out drinking
tonight?! What a bummer.

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
I'm bored. I wonder if
anyone would join me
for a glass of awamori?
I'm so lonely!

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
Hey... Manager.
Have a drink with me.
Are you listening?

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
You kept me waiting so
long that I drank all the
awamori. You're such a
troublemaker, Manager.

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Morning! Even I'm
surprised I made it to
work on time for once!

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
Hello nyello! It's almost
time to drink! Huh? Not
even close? I guess it's
still a little early, huh?

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
It's finally time!
Let's have a drink
in honor of tomorrow!

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
Fwah~ I always feel
sleepy in spring. Wanna
join me for a nap?

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
The heat doesn't bother
me at all. Come over here
and let's chill out
together!

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
I'm gonna look at the
moon tonight. While
drinking, of course!

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
I love eating something
hot when it's cold out.
When you're hungry,
your heart is cold, too...

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year!
I wanna drink and
eat lots of snacks
next year, too!

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Did you know there's
awamori-filled chocolate?
I'll give you one!
Say "aah"♪

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
So it's Neko Day, huh? 
It's a pretty special day!
I'll start the celebration
with a glass of awamori!

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
Let's have a lazy party
while gazing at the Milky
Way! We can snuggle
and watch the stars.

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Unya! Awamori and treats!
Let's have some candy
and a drink to go with it!

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Since cakes go on sale
tomorrow, it'd be great if
you could stock up. ...No?

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
Another year in the books.
I'm gonna eat toshikoshi
soba, drink awamori, and
take it easy~

name: Birthday Wishes 3
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
Happy birthday, Chief!
Let's pop a bottle of
vintage awamori and
drink till dawn! Cheers!

name: Birthday Wishes 2
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、飼いネコ以上））
transcription:
Happy birthday, Manager!
I got you a gift, but I
forgot it. Is it okay if I
bring it tomorrow?

name: Birthday Wishes 1
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー））
transcription:
Happy birthday, Manager!
Is some awamori okay
as a gift? I just happen
to have some with me!

name: Birthday
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（自身））
transcription:
Today's my birthday!
So you'll have to join me
for a day of drinking!

If you're free,

someone would carry
me to my room?

sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Don't stray too far,
Manager. There are some
sketchy customers nearby.

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Heh! I feel like I'm
invincible when you're
by my side, Manager!

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Need something?
If there's anything you
want me to do, don't
hesitate to ask!

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
I'm gonna go
all out today!

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
I've got this! Just
sit back and relax!

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Are you slacking off?
Get back to work!

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
I know exactly what
you're gonna say, so
just leave it to me!

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
The tables are clean and
there's no trash lying
around. Looks perfect!

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
Ugh, I'm so bored.
Isn't there anything
you need me to do?

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
You look pretty sleepy.
C'mon, snap out of it!

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
Customers are pouring in!
Let's work our butts off!

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
I'm starving! I want extra
firm tonkotsu ramen! Plus
extra veggies and garlic
from the 5th refill!

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
What a lovely spring day!
It's the perfect season
for a rambling ride
on my motorcycle!

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
Someone looks sour.
Don't let the heat get
you down! Let's give
it our all!

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
I won't let some fallen
leaves scare me. Who cares
if my tires slip a little?
I'm going full throttle!

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
Why is it so cold?!
...Not like it bothers me.
I'm ready for anything!

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year!
I'm gonna hike up to
the mountain peak so I can
catch the first sunrise!

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Here's some chocolate!
I put a lot of effort into
making it, so you better
be grateful!

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Today is Neko Day!
Let's have some crazy
fun after work!

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
I don't mind writing my
wish on a piece of paper.
It makes me feel like I'm
committing myself!

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Check out those brats
dressed up like ghosts.
Aren't they cute?!

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Merry Christmas!
Time to make those brats'
dreams come true!
Let's go for it!

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
Hey, you know what's
up, right? Make sure to
clear your schedule for
a New Year's run!

name: Birthday Wishes 3
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
Today's your birthday...
and I'm gonna make it
legendary, so get ready!

name: Birthday Wishes 2
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、飼いネコ以上））
transcription:
Happy birthday!
If there's anything you
want me to do, just
say the word, buddy!

name: Birthday Wishes 1
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー））
transcription:
Hey, hey! Today's your
birthday? Why didn't you
tell me, jerk?! I'm gonna
throw you a big party!

name: Event

The festival's started!
Hop on back! We'll be
the first ones there!

name: Home1
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Master-chan, any fish
you're itching to catch?
I'll do the prep, so
wanna go fishing with me?

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Master-chan, you free on
the next day off? Let's
go fishing! I'll take you
to a surefire spot!

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Aim for the big ones and
FISH! It's such a rush
when they're reeled in! I
wanna share it with you♪

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Scored some really great
fish at the market! I'll
make you a special meal
to reward your hard work!

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
I'm going rock fishing
next. Huh? Sounds
interesting?
Wanna tag along?

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
I'm thinking of what kind
of lure to make next! Got
any good materials in
mind? If so, hit me up!

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Hmmmmm... I can't reel
in Master-chan, so I'm
watching you like this~

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
What fish should I snag
next~? Is there any fish
you've been craving,
Manager-chan?

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
Fwaah, got nothing to do.
Oh, that cloud... It
looks like a horse
mackerel... Slrrp!

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Mornin'! Ehehe, I did
some morning fishing! I
caught a whole lot! Let's
feast on them later!

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
I'm hungry~! Hm~ What am
I in the mood for today?
Fried? Raw? Simmered?
Hmm, I want all three~!

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
Good evening! Are you
sleepy? The night's just
about to begin! C'mon,
let's go night fishing!

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
Fishing under the warm
sun is so fun~ Flathead,
rockfish, and horse
mackerel are in season!

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
It's tempting to dive in
the sea on hot days~!
I'll snag some fish
lurking in the deep, too!

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Filefish and goby are
starting to taste great~
Catfish season's over.
Maybe one last catch~?

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
The shop's like a nice
warm hug~ I nearly froze
fishing out there~! But
hey, my haul was perfect!

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year!
It's the new year,
so let's go fishing!
We might catch a big one!

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Happy Valentine's Day!
Ta-dah! My present for
you is chocolate shaped
like a fish!

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Nya! Neko Day calls for
some fish dishes! ...Huh?
I cook fish dishes all
the time? I guess I do...

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
What do you think I
wished for? ...Huh? A
good catch, you say?
How'd you guess?!

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Trick or Fishing! Easy
choice, huh? Fishing!
Huh? Trick is better?
Hmph, say fishing~!

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Natsume Santa brings the
freshest catch! Fish is
just as tasty as chicken
for celebrating Christmas!

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
Haah~ Another year's end.
I went fishing a lot.
Ehehe~ Let's eat lots of
fish again next year♪

name: Birthday Wishes 3
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
Happy birthday, Master-
chan! I'll do anything
for you today! Go on~ 
Tell me what you want~!

name: Birthday Wishes 2
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、飼いネコ以上））
transcription:
Happy birthday! Here's
your present! A wood-
carved lure just for you!
It'll snag a big catch!

name: Birthday Wishes 1
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー））
transcription:
Happy birthday!
I caught some fish
earlier, so let's have it
with everyone!

The shop is bustling

something from me?
Go ahead and tell me

name: Home6

The shop is bustling
again today. Its value

I made the right call♪

value of individuals♪

idle away the time
spent with me.

Hello. Another beautiful
day has begun.
First, let's conduct
some market research♪

It's lunchtime.
Sharing intel is a
basic part of business.
Let's eat and chat.

sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
When night comes, the
shop's mood changes.
I enjoy it when time
passes slowly.

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
Spring brings about
new beginnings.
We must create new value
to develop the shop.

sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
Summer is tough...
Can't we do something
about this humidity?
My hair is all frizzy.

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Fall has many charms,
but as a shop, we go
all in on appetites.
I'll taste test! Hehe.

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
It's freezing, but my
Persian rugs are warm
and cozy. Want to loaf
around with me? Hehe.

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year♪
This year, I shall
meet my goal of
making the shop mine.

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）

Valentine's-like trend.
Daily practice is key.
Have these chocolates♪

sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）

Nyan nyan nyan. I tried
speaking in Neko~ It
means... That's a secret--
it's embarrassing♪

sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）

Write my wish on a slip?
I only have one wish.
Hee hee, it's still a
secret. Hee hee hee.

sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）

don't give me top-class
sweets, I might snatch
away your shop, hehe.

sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）

The holy night is spent
with your beloved. The spot
next to me is wide open.

to create value for next
year. Heh, I won't say a
word. It'll just happen♪

done to me?!

take care of yourself

to be a cushion for me.
But you can't, 'cause
you're working... Hmm~~~

Rarr! Rarr rarr rarr
rarr! I'm strong!
Don't you forget it!

name: Home6

That's something tasty
you've got there...
You could share it
with me...

If you don't look at
me... I'll go nuts!

want if no one's looking!

so refreshing!
I'm going outside!

Don't wake me up...

Okay! Now use the energy
from napping to fuel your
rampage! Wake up! Get up!

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）

It's a butterfly!
Rarr rarr rarr...
Grrr~~~!

I'm used to the heat...
but I don't like how
clammy it is~ Humidity...
or whatever, go away!

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）

Fall, the season for good
appetites? Ackee and I
will keep eating!

I-I-I-It's too cold...
I'll die if you don't
crank up the heater
more...

My goal for this year?

stronger, it's all good!

chocolate! So what
about me, do I get any?

transcription:
It's way too soon to touch
a demon like Cannelé!
W-Well, I could give you
a little bit of attention.

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Keh heh. Human. You think
you can make Demon Cannelé
work for you? Fine. Shower
me with compliments.

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）

It takes guts to chat
with a demon. I guess
that deserves a little
bit of praise.

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
You have some nerve to
ignore Cannelé.

attention to me.

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
Hey, Manager... Don't tell
me you forgot about
Cannelé? N-Not like I'm
lonely or anything!

name: Home9

When a demon is bored...
who knows what

transcription:

name: Home: Summer

Even demons who can endure

The cold is seeping
into my bones...
H-Hey, can I snuggle

The dawn of a new year!
Sweet mochi and treats...
I shall indulge in total

transcription:

and romance are nonsense.
...So why does this demon
have butterflies today?

Today is... Neko Day?
Cannelé is a demon, but
since it's a special day,
I'll let you spoil me.

sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:

paper today? Cannelé only
has one wish... To corrupt
all of humanity!

Trick or treat! Now hand
over some sweets. Hee
hee... It's a mysterious
night, and I'm the star.

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）

nothing to do with demons!
...I guess I could keep
you company for a bit.

name: Home4

You seem more interested
in Sablé than before.
Ready to discuss signing
a pact with Sablé~?

name: Home5

Please go easy on
checking Sablé's work.

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）

The store feels brighter
when Sablé's around?

smile! Nee hee hee~♪

sweaty... If only there
was someone who would
dry her off~ (♥)

lo~ng stories, right?
How about we snuggle
in bed and you tell one?

Gosh! You look kind of
cold. If you give Sablé
a biiig hug, you might
warm right up.

over you today, so do your
very best.

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
It's almost lunch time.
Humans need breaks,
so rest well and then
work hard.

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
Late at night, you make
mistakes due to fatigue.
I don't expect perfection,
but be careful. I'll help.

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
The spring weather is
lovely. Both nekos
and humans think it's
wonderful.

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
The sunshine's really
strong today. Make sure
to set up a proper
sunshade fit for a neko.

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
They say autumn cuisine
is delicious. I can't wait
to try some. Please
do your best.

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
It's freezing... You can
hold me close to warm up
if you'd like. I give you
special permission.

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year. Do your
best to remain my special
human this year.
I have high hopes.

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Human customs like
Valentine's Day amuse me.
I shall present you with
chocolate. Be grateful.

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Today is Neko Day. I
presume it's for revering
us. But you do that every
day, so is this necessary?

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
Write my wish on paper?
What an amusing custom.
Good health for Meowjed,
and for a certain human.

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Trick or treat? Only those
who can handle being
tricked can trick others.
What do you think?

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Merry Christmas. I hear
the custom is to spend the
night with a loved one, so
be grateful I'm here.

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
Thank you for showing me
what a human's daily life
is like this past year.
I truly appreciate it.

name: Birthday Wishes 3
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
Happy birthday. I'm
celebrating your existence
in this world. It's a
joy to work with you...

name: Birthday Wishes 2
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、飼いネコ以上））
transcription:
It's your birthday? Why
didn't you say so sooner?
Congratulations. I hope
you have a marvelous day.

name: Birthday Wishes 1
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー））
transcription:
Apparently birthdays are
special days for humans.
So I'll wish you
a happy one.

name: Event
sceneName: ホーム会話（イベント開催時）
transcription:
The event has started.
I'll show you how it's
done, so make sure not
to cut corners.

I have found something worthwhile.

I was just thinking it's about time 
we returned to the shop.
Shall we go back together?

name: Slacking:2-3

Very well... I shall return.

To stare at me so intently in this uniform... I understand. 
It's only natural to be captivated. But do make sure you handle your responsibilities.

name: Home11
sceneName: ホーム会話_カード
transcription:
I wish to bring happiness to humans. That is the duty of a noble neko. 
But do not become dependent. You must learn to stand on your own.

name: Home12

As a sacred neko, I will bestow divine blessings upon you.
Humans will live happily under our management.

name: Home13

These hieroglyphs record the history of cats revered since ancient times. 
I too will guide humans in a way worthy of that legacy.

Smooch~~~♥ Nyahaha,
you're surprised! Maybe
I should try out more
things to surprise you~♪

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Hey, do you enjoy Ackee's
pranks? Okay, then I'm
upping my game!

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Nyahaha! What pranks
should I pull today?!
Be on your toes!

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
You won't play with
Ackee? That's lame.
--Wah! ...Just kidding.
That was just practice!

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Nyahaha! Ackee's always
full of energy!

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Hey, anything fun to do?
Ackee's bored!

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Wham! Coochie-coo~!
Poke poke♪ Hmph...
Fine, then! Ackee will
play by herself!

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
Hey, have you forgotten
about Ackee?
...It's about time
for a crazy prank!

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
You won't play with me?
Fine, I'm going to some
other shop! ...--Wah!
Nyahaha, oh, I won't!

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
I was wondering what
prank to pull to wake you
up, but you're already up.
Boooring!

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
Nyahaha! Is lunch ready
yet? Ackee's staaarving!

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
I'll prank you at night,
when it's dark~♪ Can't
wait for the morning~!
Nyahahahahaha!

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
Everyone's taking a nap,
so I have free rein to
doodle on their faces~♪

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
Nyahaha! I love summer!
Let's play water games!
Ackee brought a water gun!

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Fall, the reading season?
Fall, the arts season?
Fall's the season for
falling for pranks!

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
S-So cooold! Ackee's
frozen stiff...! If you
don't warm me up, I'll
lack the zest to prank!

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year! I'll pull
even greater pranks this
year! Look forward to it!

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
H-Here...! I'd say it's
from the heart, but I ate
it all up! Nyahaha!

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Today's Neko Day! You
must obey everything
Ackee says! Um, um...
I've got nothiiing~

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
Okay, time to pull a
prank on the wish slips--
W-Wyait, everyone's
giving me scary looks!

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Trick or trick~!
If you don't let me prank
you, I'll prank you~!

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Nyahaha! Found a present!
Time to swap it for a
jack-in-the-box... Nya?!
Th-This is mine...?

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
This year was so much fun,
being able to pull off
pranks! But I'll be good
next year! Just kidding~♪

name: Birthday Wishes 3
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
Nyahaha♪ Since it's your
birthday, Master, you can
pull a prank on Ackee♪
I'm serious!

name: Birthday Wishes 2
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、飼いネコ以上））
transcription:
Today's your birthday?
So I won't pull a prank
on you just for today...
Psych~!

transcription:
Happy birthday!
Your present is...
a voucher that lets Ackee
prank you all day!

a fun event over there!
Let's go!

name: Home2

transcription:
Do you ever find yourself
curious about me?
Hee hee♪ I'll tell you
anything♪

name: Home3

I lose track of time when
I'm with you like this.
It's only been 15
seconds, though...

name: Home4

transcription:
It appears I'm in a
rather good mood today.
I wonder if it's because
I saw you?

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
The weather sure is nice.
These kinds of days
make me want to
dance outdoors.

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
I don't get tired looking
at you. My eyes are so
drawn to you. Yes...
almost like a cat toy.

name: Home7

name: Home8

forgotten? I feel a slight
twinge of loneliness,
a squeeze in my heart.

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）

I will always stay by
your side. So--oh,
break's almost over.
I'm off.

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Oh, you're already up.
Do you feel something
special at the start of
each day?

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
Good day. Time seems
to drift... slowly and
gently in the early
afternoon.

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
The darkness of the night
gently envelops all,
freeing our minds from
daytime chaos... Hee hee♪

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
Fwah~... Hee hee♪ Want
to join me? Dozing off as
you bask in the sun is a
luxury not only to nekos.

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
Though I'm not a fan of
intense sunlight,
I don't dislike this
vast, open sky...

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
What a beautiful moon...
I find myself a touch
sentimental. I can almost
remember my past...

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
The world falls silent,
breath is tinted white.
Such a pure... achoo,
season this is.

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
I treasure the quiet
moments we share.
Now then, it's the new
year... I shall dance.

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Such bravery it is to
express hidden emotions.
So noble and brilliant...
but I keep nothing secret.

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Nya nya nya~♪
Nya nya nya nya nyaa♥
Mwar♥ Now, can you guess
what I said?

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）

You like cat ears, right?♪

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）

Anticipation for the

sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、飼いネコ以上））

And once more next year.

take responsibility!

Need something? I'm bus--
Snff snff. That smell...
Do you need a taste

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）

Haa... Another peaceful
day at La Soleil. I guess
I shouldn't expect a cake
to fall from the sky, huh?

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
If you have time to ignore
me, then you can whip up
a bunch of new cakes. I'll
handle the taste testing.

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
If you're going to ignore
me, don't bother me in the
first place. This is just
my face, I'm not sulking.

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
I'm bored. Really bored.
If I was a rock,
then I wouldn't feel
anything at all.

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Good... morning... My
brain's still half asleep.
I demand some morning cake
to activate it.

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
On a warm, cozy afternoon,
it's easy to lose focus.
I'll stay alert, so keep
making those cakes.

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
Eating something sweet at
night helps you sleep
better. I need my sleep,
so bring me bedtime cake.

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
Spring's for sakura mochi
and matcha sweets... I'm
a dango over flowers girl.
Time for a food tour.

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
It's so hot, I'll melt...
Can I cool off in the
freezer? I'll even taste
test the ice cream cake.

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Fall is about hearty fare.
Mont Blanc, sweet potato,
like it's trying to fatten
me up... Bring it on.

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
It's cold, so I'm holing
up in the kitchen. Hot
cocoa, please. And don't
skimp on the marshmallows.

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year. Now give
me my gift. I'd like a
year-long all-you-can-eat
pass for your new cakes.

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
We eat chocolate every day
so what's the big deal?
Today we give it away?
Sounds like a waste...

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
So I'm supposed to say
"nya"? Nope. It'd be out
of character for me to
butter you up like that.

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
My wish? "May I eat
delicious cake forever"...
That's all she wrote.

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Give me a treat or I'll
play a trick on you. Oh,
and the treats you always
give me don't count.

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
It's Christmas. Of course
I want a luxurious cake.
As for you... well, how
about a shoulder massage?

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
The year's over? I've been
busy trying cakes, so I
demand better conditions.
Twice the cakes next year.

I'm your personal advisor.

You had another hard day.
You should rest so you can
be ready for tomorrow♪

meeting new people.

should slip into something

 I look forward to our time together♪

We're playing basketball
after work. Don't forget!
Make it your top priority!

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Huh? My hair looks weird?
Guess you caught me at a
bad moment... But thanks!

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Talking to you puts me
in a good mood. Yep!
I feel a lot better now!

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
I'm playing basketball
later. Wanna come?
You should have some
fun sometimes!

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Why the long face? You'll
miss out on happiness
with a frown like that.
So give me a smile!

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Why don't we play some
basketball if everyone has
time? I'll go easy on you!

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Are you busy? I get a
little anxious when you
don't give me work to do.

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
Hm, where'd Master go?
Well, even standing around
counts as a workout.

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）

I'm bored... Getting some
quick weight training in
is probably out of the
question, huh?

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Morning! I ran here
again today. Morning
exercise feels great!

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
Lunchtime already?
Make sure to eat a
well-balanced meal.
Eat clean, train dirty!

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
I had a big dinner.
Now I gotta work off
all that food!
You should join me!

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
Let's have a cherry
blossom party! If they're
already gone, we can just
have a regular party!

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
Don't forget to stay
hydrated in the summer.
Want a sip of my
sports drink?

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Fall is the best season to
play sports! Huh? That's
what I do all year round?

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
They say you don't
feel cold in winter
if you keep moving.
Wanna go for a run?

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year!
Let's get in the spirit
with a game of hanetsuki!

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Happy Valentine's Day!
I got you my fave high
protein chocolate bar!

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Since it's Neko Day, let's
get everyone together and
have a party! I'm sure
it'll be a blast!

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
If I were to make a
wish, it'd probably be,
"I hope I get better at
playing basketball."

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Trick or treat!
Instead of candy, you'll
let me work out? Hahaha!
You're hilarious!

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
I can't wait for today's
Christmas party! If you
don't hurry up, I might
run over and get you!

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
Yep! Another great year
in the books! Let's work
hard so we can say the
same for next year!

sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））

It's just the two of us

what I got you!

going to celebrate today,
so don't make any plans!

sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Why do you keep looking at
my face? You like me that
much?

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
I'm sorry, I'm sorry!
Oh, you weren't angry?♪
Okay♪

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
What do you want? I'm in
the mood for a luxurious
tea time, by the way.

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
If you insist,
I wouldn't refuse to 
stick around and listen.

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Hmph, you're always so
busy. You should spend
your time more comfortably
like I do.

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
What's with you? Could you
not touch me so casually
like that? A-At least do
it harder... Wait, no!

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
How heartless of you to
ignore me!
O-Or was that a reward?

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
Hey, Manager!
Pay attention
to me already!

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Now work hard for me
again today!

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
I've gotten rather
drowsy... Hey, you
could at least give me
a lap pillow.

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
Did you want to stay up
late with me?
Fine, I'll make an
exception for you.

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
Hey, take me to cherry
blossom viewing with you.
And don't forget to bring
a top-class bento!

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
Hey, isn't it too hot?!
Prepare a cool place
for me!

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Prepare something tastier
than this shop's wares!
Ah... Sorry! I got
too cocky!

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
What are you going to do
if I catch a cold?
Do something about it!

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year. Well, I'm
sticking around again this
year, so be grateful!

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Well... take it anyway.
It's chocolate from me.
Be grateful for the honor!

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
I heard today's Neko Day.
Every day is a day you
devote yourself to
me, right?

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
I wrote ""Honor me"" on the
strip of paper! Huh?
I'm sorry! I overstepped
my boundaries~~~!

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
I'll play a trick on you
if you don't give me
treats! I-I don't mind
getting tricked myself...

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
I look forward to being
satisfied. If your gift is
lame... you'll be
punished.

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
You sure served me
well this year.
Keep it up for
next year as well.

name: Birthday Wishes 3
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
Happy birthday. A present?
Hee hee, I'll stay
by your side.

name: Birthday Wishes 2
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、飼いネコ以上））

Today's your birthday,
right? I'll give you my
greetings!

name: Birthday Wishes 1

I heard it was your
birthday. Hmm.
I suppose it's worth
celebrating.

name: Event
sceneName: ホーム会話（イベント開催時）

staring at me so much?
...I don't really hate it
or anything, though...

name: Home2
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：恋ネコ）
transcription:
You're messing up my
flow... But if you don't
stay by my side, it'll get
worse, so stay here.

name: Home3
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
Hey, you're being too
familiar with me.
Well, I'll allow it
just this once.

name: Home4
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値高）
transcription:
I'll watch over you to
make sure you're actually
doing your job... You'd
better be grateful.

name: Home5
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
What? Do you need me for
something? If not, could
you please not talk to me?

name: Home6
sceneName: ホーム会話（汎用：関係値ー）
transcription:
Do your job properly.
If you slack off, I'll be
the first to tell you off.

name: Home7
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：恋ネコ）
transcription:
Hey, Master... How long
will you keep me hanging?
You keep looking at other
nekos... It's unfair!

name: Home8
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値高）
transcription:
You've got guts ignoring
me. I-It's not like I want
you to pay attention to me
or anything!

name: Home9
sceneName: ホーム会話（放置：関係値ー）
transcription:
Hmph. Who you talk to
is none of my business...

name: Home: Morning
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_朝）
transcription:
Fwah... Wh-What?!
I-It's not like I'm
sleepy or anything!

name: Home: Noon
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_昼）
transcription:
Welcome to La Soleil...
Oh, it's you. Looks like
you're working hard.
I suppose that's a given.

name: Home: Night
sceneName: ホーム会話（時間差分_夜）
transcription:
It's already late...
...You should hurry and go
home, too... Not like I'm
concerned about you.

name: Home: Spring
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_春）
transcription:
It's nice and warm. Feels
so relaxi... Wait, nya?!
I'm not trying to climb
onto your lap!

name: Home: Summer
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
No slacking off because
of the heat! Here!
At least hydrate yourself!

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Don't eat too much just
because Fall's the season
of good eating! ...Huh?
Say, ah? I-I'll have that!

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
S-So cold... I-I'm only
clinging to you because
it's warm by your side!

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year.
Treat everyone equally
again this year!

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Th-This is obligatory!
Don't get the wrong idea!
I'm handing it out to
others, too--equally!

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Sure, it's Neko Day, but I
won't do anything special.
...You can pet me, though.
...D-Do it gently!

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
I wish I could be with you
forever... i-is not what
I'm thinking at all!

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
No tricks allowed here!
...Here, some sweets.
That should do, right?

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
A Christmas present?
I'm a good girl, so
I'll get one, of course♪

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
This year's come to an
end. I'll look after you
next year, as well.

name: Birthday Wishes 3
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
I-It's your birthday,
right? W-Well, I guess
I'll celebrate...
Happy birthday.

name: Birthday Wishes 2
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、飼いネコ以上））
transcription:
It's your birthday,
right?! ...Well, that's a
cause for celebration.
Happy birthday.

name: Birthday Wishes 1
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー））
transcription:
Your birthday isn't an
excuse to slack off.
...Anyway, happy
birthday.

sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_夏）
transcription:
It's so hot!
Time to cool off by
jumping in a river!
Let's go together!

name: Home: Autumn
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_秋）
transcription:
Look, look!
This leaf is so pretty!
Let's go look for more!

name: Home: Winter
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_冬）
transcription:
Brrr! You can snuggle
closer. I'll be your
personal pocket heater!

name: New Year
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_新年）
transcription:
Happy New Year!
Let's play together a lot
and eat lots of cake
this year, too!

name: Valentine's Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_バレンタイン）
transcription:
Here! I worked really hard
on it! It's really sparkly
and pretty, right?

name: Neko Day
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_猫の日）
transcription:
Nyan nyan nya~n!
It's Neko Day!
And since it's my day,
give me lots of cake!

name: Tanabata
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_七夕）
transcription:
I made a wish on a star!
That we could stay
together forever!

name: Halloween
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_ハロウィン）
transcription:
Trick or treat!
If you don't give me
candy, I'll scratch you
with my claws!

name: Christmas
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_クリスマス）
transcription:
Merry Christmas!
What did you ask for?
I asked for the
world's biggest cake!

name: Year-End
sceneName: ホーム会話（時節差分_年の瀬）
transcription:
Year-End? I dunno about
that, but I had a blast!
Here's to the new year!

name: Birthday Wishes 3
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、恋ネコ以上））
transcription:
Happy birthday! Tee hee♪
I love you~!

name: Birthday Wishes 2
sceneName: ホーム会話（誕生日（ユーザー、飼いネコ以上））
transcription:
Happy birthday!
Is there cake?!
Can I have some?!

Happy birthday!
I'll help out as much
as I can today!
